text:
I had a hair transplant at this clinic. It was over a thousand dollars more than advertised, but I'm happy with the quality of the work and the staff's attitude. I used to think it was impossible to find a quality hair transplant clinic in Thailand and that I'd have to fly to Turkey, but I was wrong. They guarantee hair growth, offer a free annual hair wash, provide all the vitamins and hair care products, and provide consultations on all matters. I recommend this clinic.
